title: MatterGen: materials design with a generative model
summary: A diffusion model trained on 608,000 stable materials. Compound TaCr2O6, generated with a constraint of 200 GPa bulk modulus, was synthesized and measured at 169 GPa (relative error under 20%), but with Ta–Cr disorder differing from the proposed structure. One experimental example.

evidence.tested: The generated TaCr2O6 structure was synthesized and its bulk modulus measured at 169 GPa against the 200 GPa target, with relative error under 20%.
evidence.unknown: The source reports one experimental example, with Ta-Cr disorder differing from the proposed structure, and cites no separate publication for this compound.
evidence.ai_role: MatterGen, a diffusion model conditioned on a 200 GPa bulk modulus, generated the structure.
